As Chhath Puja approaches, New Delhi Railway Station is witnessing an extraordinary rush of passengers heading to Bihar to celebrate the festival with their families.
Platforms 14 and 15 are packed with thousands of homebound passengers. To manage the massive crowd and ensure smooth movement, the Railway Protection Force (RPF) has put up barricades and ropes along the platforms.
Watch this ground report from New Delhi Railway Station to see how passengers are navigating the long queues, barricades and massive rush to reach home for Chhath Puja.
